title: The understanding conversation: built and measured, and its gate failed twice, recorded as failed
request: Milestone C: DCLab asks the questions that settle the problem, reads 'it is anomaly detection' into the problem card, shows contradictions, and shows the card to confirm, with a model role at each step measured against the rules before it is on.
spec: The next question chosen by what it decides; answers mapped to the card by a model role with a validator and the rules as fallback; contradictions shown; the card shown to confirm. Done when a set of written conversations (dev and sealed), one per family, reaches the right card in at most five questions, with the gate fixed before the run.
plan: The conversation in dclab_core: the card of a conversation, the next question, the reading of an answer, a whole conversation played, the summary to confirm.
A reader role behind a validator, off until measured.
A harness with dev and sealed written conversations and a gate fixed before any run; Home wired to read answers and show the card.

decisions.decision: A sealed failure stays recorded, and a spent sealed set is never run again.
decisions.why: Tuning on a sealed set, or re-running it after a fix, would make its result meaningless.

decisions.decision: No third sealed set by the author of the rules.
decisions.why: Writing it knowing the rules' weak spots is a form of tuning; it must come from someone else.

decisions.decision: The kind of answer is read only from an answer to that question or when said outright.
decisions.why: A word in passing ('the customer segment', 'no known cases') locked in a wrong family as stated, which no later word could override.

change: dclab_core/conversation.py (new; dclab-core 0.16.0), dclab_core/prompts/conversation_reader.md, dclab_core/card.py (time-to-event words), dclab_rnd/agent_eval/conversation/ (new harness and its sets), evidence/campaigns/conversation_v1, dclab_rnd/models/settings.py (purpose), dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py and card.py (Home), home.html; tests/test_conversation.py (new), test_model_data_limits.py; CHANGELOG, CLAUDE.md, the plan, the roadmap.

findings.defect: Asking the card's questions on drafts with no data changed Home's established flow.
findings.scenario: Five draft-flow tests expected a summary and got a question.
findings.cause: The card's blocking questions were asked whenever the plan ended.
findings.fix: Only once a table is analysed, only the labels, kind or outcome, within Home's four questions.

findings.defect: The sealed v1 run failed the gate: 8 of 9.
findings.scenario: 'The time until each customer cancels the subscription' read as a regression.
findings.cause: The time-to-event words required the event right after 'until'.
findings.fix: Words made general, with whole verbs; the result recorded as failed and the set spent.

findings.defect: The sealed v2 run failed the gate: 8 of 9.
findings.scenario: 'Tell which insurance claims will be disputed': the kind of answer asked first, never settled.
findings.cause: With no outcome named the family question came first, and written conversations carry no column values.
findings.fix: The outcome is asked first; a host may pass the outcome's kind. Recorded as failed; the set spent.

findings.defect: A casual answer locked in a wrong family as stated, and a fraud draft with no known cases was built as rare events.
findings.scenario: 'No known cases' to the labels question; 'whether a customer cancels in the next month' as the outcome.
findings.cause: Family words were read in every answer and recorded as stated.
findings.fix: The family only from its own question or said outright; never rare events when nothing is confirmed.

findings.defect: Answers were misread in the core API.
findings.scenario: A yes or no read as a number; 'profile' read as a file; 'no, a column marks them' read as none; a named column dropped.
findings.cause: Order of the patterns and substring tests.
findings.fix: Yes or no before numbers; whole words; a column before a leading no; a named column always kept.

findings.defect: The widened time words turned durations into time to an event.
findings.scenario: Time to process returned parcels; diesel; breakfast.

findings.defect: The reader's validator kept a moment the model wrote.
findings.scenario: Quote 'at' kept 'after the final fare is known'.
findings.cause: A substring quote check with no length.
findings.fix: Whole words, at least two words or four characters; free text only as words of the answer; a column named in its quote.

findings.defect: The new purpose had no data-limit test.
findings.fix: A test that the reader sees one answer and column names, never values.

findings.defect: A spent sealed set could still be measured by another arm, and a paid run stored no spend.
findings.fix: Spent for every arm; the spend stored.

findings.defect: The record of the measurement left out what weakens it.
findings.scenario: Dev cases written from the sealed failures; sealed v2 written right after a rule change, using its words.
findings.fix: Stated in the dev cases, the manifest and the status line.

findings.defect: With a model, Home never read answers into the card.
findings.scenario: The record tool took the answer without the card reading.
findings.cause: Only the script path called it.
findings.fix: The record tool reads the person's own last message.

findings.defect: The files did not come first, and contradictions were not asked.
findings.scenario: The made-up outcome question before a file question; 20.4's contradictions unused.
findings.cause: No check of open file and label questions; no contradictions passed.
findings.fix: The outcome question only when no file or label question is open; Home asks 20.4's contradictions first, with fields of their own.

findings.defect: The score and the verdict had no test.
findings.scenario: A verdict always 'pass' passed the suite.
findings.cause: Only the dev run was tested.

measurements.name: sealed v1, rules
measurements.gate: conversation_gate_v1: every conversation reaches the right card in at most five questions
limits: Nine written conversations; not every family is covered.

measurements.name: sealed v2, rules
measurements.gate: conversation_gate_v2: the same criteria on a new sealed set
limits: Written by the author of the rules right after a rule change: not independent.

measurements.name: planted faults
measurements.gate: each fix undone fails a test
measurements.result: 7 of 11 caught at first; tests sharpened, then 10 of 11; the 11th (a default argument) is never used by the command line

outcome: The conversation is built: it asks what unblocks the most, reads answers into the problem card without taking a word in passing for a decision, and shows the card to confirm. Its gate failed on two sealed sets, 8 of 9 each. Both failures are recorded, the sets are spent, and the next sealed set must come from someone other than the author of the rules.
lessons: A rule that records what the person 'stated' must hear it said, not infer it from a word in passing.
When a sealed set fails, record it and stop; a new set written by the same hand right after a fix is not independent.
Dev cases written from sealed failures make dev scores optimistic: say so where the score is reported.
risks: The reader role is unmeasured and off.
Three families (entity tables, streams, text or images) are not covered by the conversations.
